change_note: diversification/1.0 -> diversification/1.1 (2026-10-24, quant-analyst subagent): registry_id; issued; change_note; common.implementation_version cites diversification/1.1, risk/1.10 and market-data/1.15, the labels the code runs (PD-0067 decision 6; review M-2 of the code-label move, 2026-10-24; CP5 change note 1.0 -> 1.1). common.frequency.grid and common.reason_rule keep 'risk/1.9 section 2' and 'risk/1.9 section 7.3': they cite where those rules are defined, and risk/1.10 leaves both sections unchanged. status is the 1.0 text, unchanged, although PD-0041 decision 1 has since decided OD-CP5-01 (FULL_NAV); this re-issue changes the labels only. No entry changes, and every other field is as authored by quant-analyst (native Codex). DIVERSIFICATION_1.0_REGISTRY.json stays unchanged as the record.
status: Candidate full-NAV method pending owner OD-CP5-01; implementation/validation only; not HG3 approval or user policy.

common.notation: T=sum nonzero complete NAV bucket values; w_i=v_i/T; S_ij=sum_k(r_i,k-mean_i)(r_j,k-mean_j); C_ij=S_ij/(n-1); A=260 DAILY,52 WEEKLY,12 MONTHLY.

frequency.grid: risk/1.9 section 2 full periods, weekday/Friday/month-end; stubs declared

lookback.rule: requested grid only; no implicit shortening or missing-period deletion

states_snapshot.condition: complete nonnegative positive NAV and all valuations AVAILABLE

states_history.condition: n below available_from but at least insufficient_below

drift_absolute: signature missing/different, future or same-date baseline

common.reason_rule: performance/1.12 section 1.5 and risk/1.9 section 7.3: worst cause state, reason only from same-level causes; no new reason codes
common.fx_treatment: Exact reporting-currency values; listing quotation/native cash/receivable currency. Historical total-return leg translated on CP4 grid with exact FX cross term.
common.corporate_action_treatment: CP3 valuation and CP4 total-return action rules; no price/action double count and no unconfirmed total-return coverage.

capital_universe.actual: USER_CONFIRMED plus immutable scoped owner decision evidence; no actual confirmation exists at issue
capital_universe.synthetic: explicit SYNTHETIC_CANDIDATE only if all contributing inputs verified synthetic

entries.human_definition: Largest share of complete reporting NAV in one listing, currency cash bucket or currency receivable bucket.
data_inputs: complete CP3 reporting-currency valuation and bucket identity
entries.minimum_observations: one complete as-of valuation; no historical minimum
entries.risk_free_rate_dependency: none; cash leg does not invent an interest rate
known_limitations: Includes cash and receivables.
Multiple listings of an issuer are not combined.

wording.must_keep: denominator/reference, as-of, currency and classification/acceptance limitations

entries.human_definition: Linear association between two current security listings' reporting-currency total-return histories.
data_inputs: complete current reporting-currency bucket values and exact weights
complete aligned total-return/FX-only legs and input provenance
entries.risk_free_rate_dependency: none; cash leg does not invent an interest rate
entries.missing_data_handling: common.reason_rule; common.states_history; every required period/leg, no deletion or renormalization
known_limitations: Not causality or a forecast.
Zero variance is undefined, not zero correlation.
Only the two named legs are required.

wording.must_keep: current-weight model, exact window, frequency, n and thresholds, reporting currency, synthetic marker and exclusions

entries.human_definition: Average distinct-security correlation weighted by products of their current capital weights.
entries.formula: sum_{i<j in SECURITY} w_i*w_j*rho_ij / sum_{i<j in SECURITY} w_i*w_j
data_inputs: complete current reporting-currency bucket values and exact weights
complete aligned total-return/FX-only legs and input provenance
entries.risk_free_rate_dependency: none; cash leg does not invent an interest rate
entries.missing_data_handling: common.reason_rule; common.states_history; every required period/leg, no deletion or renormalization
known_limitations: Excludes cash and receivables; coverage disclosed.
Requires every pair; no zero-variance or missing-leg deletion.
No diagonal and no averaging rounded pair values.

wording.must_keep: current-weight model, exact window, frequency, n and thresholds, reporting currency, synthetic marker and exclusions

entries.metric_name: Historical covariance volatility at current weights
entries.human_definition: Annualized volatility of the fixed-current-weight combination of historical reporting-currency capital-bucket legs.
entries.annualization_convention: square-root-of-time sqrt(A); A=260/52/12; historical covariance model
data_inputs: complete current reporting-currency bucket values and exact weights
complete aligned total-return/FX-only legs and input provenance
entries.risk_free_rate_dependency: none; cash leg does not invent an interest rate
entries.missing_data_handling: common.reason_rule; common.states_history; every required period/leg, no deletion or renormalization
known_limitations: Not actual held historical portfolio volatility or a forecast.
Cash/receivables use fixed nominal FX-only returns; no interest or credit-risk claim.
Singular covariance is allowed.

wording.must_keep: current-weight model, exact window, frequency, n and thresholds, reporting currency, synthetic marker and exclusions
